experiment: Train XLM-R NER with D3 from the start, then compare validation against saved Lab 3 predictions
split_policy: Same template-disjoint split as Lab 3; evaluate on validation only
decision_rule: Record LOCATION recall and aggregate entity F1; retain original model if there is no quality gain.
interpretation: Follow-up development experiment after the fixed-model ablation; not independent held-out evidence and not proof of the +4 course target.
